_about: Validation suite config. Every value here is environment-specific -- do not commit a filled-in copy with secrets or machine paths you do not want shared. Env vars of the same name in UPPER_SNAKE override the values below. Model provenance (path + sha256) is recorded per model under models/*.json; `bin/vmodel diff ffds` re-derives the facts and reports any drift.

cameo._host_workspace: RESOLVED 2026-09-26 from the running server, not from the sources: admin_get_model_status reported the open model's fileName as /home/mac/oc3/workspace/SAF-Cameo-Profile/SAF_Plugin/samples/SAF/SAF_FFDS.mdzip. This matches scripts/tool_contract_resources.groovy and contradicts scripts/admin_bridge.groovy, which says /home/mac/opencode/workspace. Override with CAMEO_HOST_WORKSPACE if your checkout lives elsewhere.
cameo._test_models: Test models keyed by task id. Values are paths AS THE HOST SEES THEM, because Cameo loads by host path while the harness runs in a container; `bin/vmodel locate` maps one to the other. The mutating task uses a disposable copy taken from the distribution's own sample, so the pristine samples in the SAF profile repo are never loaded by a writing cell at all.
cameo._profile_repo: Container-side path of the SAF-Cameo-Profile checkout, which supplies the sample models the task dataset is grounded in. The suite references a checkout rather than vendoring the models as a git submodule: they are 11.7 MB of binary that upstream revises on its own schedule, and a recorded sha256 (see models/*.json) is the reproducibility we actually need. Override with SAF_PROFILE_REPO.
cameo._dist: Container-side path of the Cameo distribution. Its samples/SAF/ holds the same SAF_FFDS.mdzip the profile repo does (byte-identical, sha256 verified), and it is not a git tree -- so a disposable model copy belongs here and dirties nothing. `bin/vmodel locate` asks the running server where its model actually is and is the authority over this value. Override with CAMEO_DIST.
cameo._scratch_dir: Where disposable model copies live. Nowhere near the Cameo installation: a plugin install is deployed, versioned state and the wrong place for an experiment's throwaway files, and it is not a git tree, so nothing kept here can dirty a repository. It sits in the shared subtree, so the harness can hash what Cameo opens; `bin/vpath` translates the path in both directions and `vpath verify-model` proves the translation by having the running server open a model through it. Override with VALIDATION_SCRATCH_DIR. Populate it with `bin/vmodel provision SAF_FFDS`, which copies the model together with its entire transitive dependency closure and mirrors the distribution layout. The dependencies matter: an .mdzip points at other .mdzips by bare filename, so a lone copy carries references that resolve to nothing and fail silently.

models._about: Catalogue of local models under test, keyed by a short name passed to --model. Populate with the models you actually want on the scaling curve. 'provider' + 'base_url' + 'model' + 'context' + 'max_output' are written verbatim into the per-run opencode.json.
